shortDescription: Get and Set Plug Parameters on WTI OOB and PDU power devices

options.name: cpm_action
options.description: This is the Action to send the module.

options.name: cpm_password
options.description: This is the Password of the WTI device to send the module.

options.name: cpm_url
options.description: This is the URL of the WTI device to send the module.

options.name: cpm_username
options.description: This is the Username of the WTI device to send the module.

options.name: plug_bootdelay
options.description: On a reboot command, this is the time when a plug will turn on power, after it has been turned off. 0='0.5 Secs', 1='1 Sec', 2='2 Sec', 3='5 Sec', 4='15 Sec', 5='30 Sec', 6='1 Min', 7='2 Mins', - 8='3 Mins', 9='5 Mins'.

options.name: plug_bootpriority
options.description: Prioritizes which plug gets its state changed first. The lower the number the higher the priority. Valid value can from 1 to the maximum number of plugs of the WTI unit.

options.name: plug_default
options.description: What the Plugs default state is when the device starts. 0 - Off, 1 - On.

options.name: plug_id
options.description: This is the plug number that is to be manipulated For the getplugconfig command, the plug_id 'all' will return the status of all the plugs the user has rights to access.

options.name: plug_name
options.description: The new name of the Plug.

options.name: use_https
options.description: Designates to use an https connection or http connection.

options.name: use_proxy
options.description: Flag to control if the lookup will observe HTTP proxy environment variables when present.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If false, SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.
